name: PowOS desktop home (powos-shell)
purpose: The web shell's home (grid, widgets, PowOS AI's pill and chat, the pet) as a layer surface under every window of the phone's Plasma session, beside plasmashell. Off unless started: powos-desktop-shell start|stop|status. Built on the phone from the repo by sources/powos-shell/dev/phone.sh build against the rootfs's own Qt/QtWebEngine/LayerShellQt (no packages installed).

processes.name: powos-shell home (+ QtWebEngineProcess zygotes, renderer, GPU)
processes.started_by: powos-desktop-shell start (by hand or sources/powos-shell/dev/phone.sh start); no autostart

remove: powos-desktop-shell stop; rm -rf /usr/lib/powos/desktop-shell /usr/bin/powos-desktop-shell /usr/share/applications/org.powos.shell.desktop /var/tmp/powos-shell-src /var/tmp/powos-shell-build /home/powos/.local/share/powos-shell /home/powos/.cache/powos-shell (shell-data's desktop-* files are the desktop's layout and chat)
